name: Jack Schlossberg
subject: Jack Schlossberg here
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?refcode=111325_1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?refcode=111325_1]
It's official...
I'm running to represent NY-12 in Congress! This is the district where I was born and raised, and the place that five generations of my family have called home.
Hi Peter, I'm Jack Schlossberg, and my grandfather, President Kennedy, is my hero.
In high school, I spent hours watching his speeches. He taught us all that politics isn't about serving yourself — it's about serving others. And that's exactly why I'm running for Congress.
This isn't going to be your average campaign — we’re at the forefront of a movement backed by real people who are ready for a new generation of leadership. I won't be bought or intimidated. Instead, I'll be relying on folks like you. So, if you're willing to be one of the first donors to my campaign, will you split a donation between myself and Real Texas PAC right now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?refcode=111325_1]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation to Jack Schlossberg and The Real Texas PAC will go through immediately:
DONATE $5 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?express_lane=true&refcode=111325_1&amount=5]
DONATE $10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?express_lane=true&refcode=111325_1&amount=10]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?express_lane=true&refcode=111325_1&amount=50]
DONATE $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?express_lane=true&refcode=111325_1&amount=100]
DONATE $250 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?express_lane=true&refcode=111325_1&amount=250]
Other Amount [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?refcode=111325_1&amount=25]
I've always been passionate about politics — you can probably gather as much if you've seen any of my social media posts :) I pride myself on my hot (correct!) takes. But public service has always been my driving force. I come from a long legacy of public service, from my great-great-grandparents to my mother, Caroline Kennedy.
I have big shoes to fill. I've known it all my life. But this is even bigger than living up to my family name. This is about serving the people of New York — the city that shaped me into the person I am today.
Right now, our country is in crisis. Donald Trump and his buddies (my cousin RFK Jr. — to name just one) are tanking the economy, attacking free speech, and sowing distrust in decades of scientific research.
We need to revive empathy and effort. I want to be excited and feel hopeful about our future, and I want my fellow New Yorkers to feel the same way. I believe in a politics that works for the people it was intended to serve, and I'm ready to fight for it.
And Peter, I happen to think caring is cool.
None of this will be easy. But in the words of my grandfather, I'm doing this "Not because it is easy but because it is hard."
Together, we can build a new Congress and a New York City that works for everyone. Will you join our movement today by splitting a donation of any amount between my campaign and Real Texas PAC ? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?refcode=111325_1]
Talk soon,
Jack

I won’t sugarcoat it, Peter, Donald Trump’s authoritarian takeover of our democracy is in full swing. Over the past nine months, we have watched as Donald Trump has weaponized the Department of Justice as a tool to target his political adversaries — undermining the very fabric of the democratic institutions this country was founded on. **And now, Trump has brought the fight to New York. Trump recently directed his former insurance lawyer-turned-U.S. Attorney to indict New York Attorney General Letitia James on bogus federal charges.** The reason? Pure revenge and retribution because Tish James did her job and held Trump and his business accountable for committing fraud for years and years. We cannot ignore this flagrant abuse of power. This is exactly why I recently introduced the **_Preventing Political Prosecutions Act_** with Senator Richard Blumenthal. This legislation is designed to prevent any president, present or future, from weaponizing the DOJ for personal vendettas against political opponents. We must ensure that justice remains impartial and immune from political interference. **If we allow Trump’s actions to go unchecked, any one of us who dares to speak out — _including you and me_ — could be the next target.** **[Please stand with me as I fight to maintain the integrity of our justice system and ensure that the rule of law prevails over partisanship and manipulation. I'm just a geologist-turned-brewer who entered public service to do what's right for the people of my state.

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/119211057/582304337/-1473932214?refcode=logo&amount=10&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83MjY1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZWFkZmQ1Ny1hYWMwLWYwMTEtODE5Ni02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-Dyz-FOac0gC7jbmsULcWfDECVd4qhACaj_57OnG66k=) I'll be honest, folks. I never saw myself serving in the U.S. Senate.

This is a longer email about my story and how I came to fight for hardworking Coloradans in the Senate, and I hope you’ll read it until the end. **[But if you don’t have time, please, take a moment and chip in a couple bucks to my campaign before time runs out on our mid-month deadline. →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/119211058/582304338/910623595?amount=15&refcode=email_111325_bio-rs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83MjY1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZWFkZmQ1Ny1hYWMwLWYwMTEtODE5Ni02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-Dyz-FOac0gC7jbmsULcWfDECVd4qhACaj_57OnG66k=)** | | [Donate →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/119211059/582304339/910623595?amount=15&refcode=email_111325_bio-rs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83MjY1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZWFkZmQ1Ny1hYWMwLWYwMTEtODE5Ni02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-Dyz-FOac0gC7jbmsULcWfDECVd4qhACaj_57OnG66k=)

Back in the mid-1980s, I was a geologist – until I was laid off for 27 months. Then, I took every scrap of savings in my bank account and took a gamble on opening my own business, Wynkoop Brewing Company, in downtown Denver.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/119211060/582304340/41684922?amount=15&refcode=email_111325_bio-rs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83MjY1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZWFkZmQ1Ny1hYWMwLWYwMTEtODE5Ni02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-Dyz-FOac0gC7jbmsULcWfDECVd4qhACaj_57OnG66k=)
I remember working 80-hour weeks. I remember lying awake at night wondering how we were going to make it. And I remember being so angry that my government wasn't working for me.

So, I ran for Mayor. And once elected, I focused every day on making decisions based on what was best for Denver.

Then, I was elected Governor on the premise of uniting people, finding common ground, hashing things out, and getting things done.

And after we flipped Colorado’s Senate seat in 2020, I got my hands dirty working hard to deliver real change for Coloradans. We invested billions of dollars to confront the climate crisis, lowered prescription drug costs, made investments to rebuild our infrastructure, and brought thousands of good-paying manufacturing jobs back to America.

But look, I’ve also seen how broken Washington is. I see politicians who only listen to those who cut big campaign checks while ignoring the rest of us. And it’s clear we need more leaders who are willing to cut through the political deadlock and work to move this country forward.

Here's why I'm telling you this: **my story is the reason I remain grounded amid the nonsense and dysfunction that's happening in our government.**

Because with all the chaos in Washington, you need somebody who rolls up their sleeves and fights every day for all of us – not just those they agree with.

Like I said, I never thought I'd find myself in the U.S. Senate, but I’m running for re-election because Coloradans deserve a leader they can trust to do right by them. And I'm just a geologist-turned-brewer who entered public service to do what's right for the people of my state.

That’s why I don't take money from corporate PACs like your typical politician. Instead, I rely on grassroots folks like you. And it’s why I'm depending on your contribution today to help us meet our upcoming mid-month fundraising goal. Even just $5 here or $10 there goes a long way in a campaign like ours.
**[So I have to ask: will you make a donation of whatever is meaningful to you before our deadline ends Saturday night? Together, we can defend this seat we flipped back in 2020 and keep power in the hands of Coloradans:](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/119211061/582304341/910623595?amount=15&refcode=email_111325_bio-rs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83MjY1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZWFkZmQ1Ny1hYWMwLWYwMTEtODE5Ni02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-Dyz-FOac0gC7jbmsULcWfDECVd4qhACaj_57OnG66k=)**

clean_body: One week ago, the Oregon DOJ went to the US Supreme Court to put an end to Trump's illegal tariffs. | | | | | | | | | | | Friends, Last week, the Oregon Department of Justice went to the US Supreme Court to put a stop to the President's illegal tariffs that are making it hard for working families put food on the table. President Trump knows his tariffs hurt families the most, and during that hearing, the Trump administration admitted that Americans are paying as much as 80% of the cost of these tariffs. 80%! Our team is not about to let Trump get away with this. | "Help us stop him" | Working families are paying the price as President Trump continues to prioritize his political agenda, not the American people.** By bypassing Congress, the President's use of tariffs is another form of taxation without representation. That's why it's absolutely essential that we verify as many voter records as possible so we know __exactly__ how many votes we can count on. (This will help us spend our limited resources as efficiently as possible).

The Democrats can verify all the voters they want: As long as Republicans have a fully verified voter file, I'm confident that we'll win the midterms in a landslide...

_...but without one, President Trump's Senate GOP majority is in grave danger._

In case you needed another sign that this work is critical and effective:
Peter,

Just like the Supreme Court win in Wisconsin earlier this year, these victories are proof of a growing momentum across the country. These are the leaders who will govern with dignity and respect from day one, and who refuse to get caught up in the partisan games that have paralyzed our politics for far too long.

**THANK YOU, ROANOKE!** I thank the people of Roanoke for giving me an opportunity to continue doing what I love. It has been the honor of my life to serve in the area where I grew up and where I am now raising my family. We have proven that standing up for the education of our children, fighting for human rights everywhere in this world, and standing up to greedy special interests is a winning strategy. Please do not hesitate to reach out to my office if we can ever be of assistance.

name: Justin Balik, Evergreen
subject: NEW REPORT: How NJ can turn the tide on rising energy costs
body:
What it takes to help save New Jerseyans $467 each year
| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4200796/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
| Electric bills have been rising, but Evergreen and NRDC have partnered to unveil a new report from Synapse Energy Economics that details the state policy playbook that can save the average New Jersey household $467 per year on electric bills. [SUPPORT OUR WORK](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4200797/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| Hi Friend,

Right now, soaring power demand from data centers is straining energy supplies and driving up our energy costs. On top of that, high utility profit margins and the Trump administration’s attacks on clean sources of energy are making this problem worse.

**So it’s no surprise that Mikie Sherrill won the New Jersey governor’s race running on affordable, clean energy and a promise to tackle these problems head on.**

In New Jersey, energy supply strain and demand growth have contributed to **a whopping _17 to 20 percent_ jump in electric bills** this past June.

If left unchecked, costs will continue to rise, making it harder for working families to get by.

In a [new report just released with Synapse Energy Economics](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4200798/87SdQ4wZ), we outline concrete steps that can be taken to help save the average New Jersey household **$467 per year.** With electric bills on track to rise sharply through the end of the decade, these savings can deliver tangible relief to families while laying the groundwork for lasting reform.

That’s why **Evergreen is laser-focused on getting these policy recommendations in front of as many New Jersey decision-makers as possible in the coming weeks** , especially as a new administration and newly elected legislature prepare to take office. [**Can we count on your support to help fuel that push?**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4200799/87SdQ4wZ) |
---
[POWER OUR WORK](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4200800/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| The actions outlined in the report could lower monthly power bills for New Jersey residents by up to 12 percent—which adds up to **$14.3 _billion_ in total savings statewide by 2030.**

The work our team did these past few months to release this playbook, and the work we’ll do to release more of them in the coming months, is fueled by your support.

If we want to continue to provide decision-makers with the playbooks that can lower energy costs and reduce dangerous climate pollution, [**we need your help to continue to fund this kind of in-depth policy research and analysis. Make a gift of any amount today.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4200801/87SdQ4wZ) |
---
| Thanks for your continued engagement. |
---
| | |
---
### Justin Balik
Vice President, States
Evergreen Collaborative

name: Chuck Rocha
subject: Congratulations Rep. Adelita Grijalva on your Confirmation -- Becoming the First Latina to Represent Arizona! 🥳
body:
| | | |
---
| | |
---
|
We are proud to celebrate the confirmation of Representative Adelita Grijalva to the United States Congress. Her seating was long overdue. For more than seven weeks, Arizona families were left without representation because of an unjustified procedural delay that undermined trust in our institutions and denied voters their rightful voice in Washington.

During this time, **[Climate Power en Acción](https://solidaritystrategies.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=985fddf6f660c0281e297f819&id=7bbf9df212&e=b8f90417f9)** worked tirelessly to confront the delay and defend the democratic rights of Arizonans. CPEA united civil rights, environmental justice, and community partners and led a [national sign-on letter ](https://solidaritystrategies.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=985fddf6f660c0281e297f819&id=b580fda451&e=b8f90417f9)urging Speaker Mike Johnson to seat Representative Grijalva. CPEA also carried out strategic outreach, amplified Latina leaders across the country, and ensured this obstruction was met with strong and visible pressure.
---
| [ ](https://solidaritystrategies.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=985fddf6f660c0281e297f819&id=22795d8cc7&e=b8f90417f9)
---
| Representative Grijalva also led a powerful effort of her own. Even while blocked from taking her seat, she launched one of the most effective media campaigns of this moment. Her message reached audiences nationwide and made it clear that Arizonans deserved their representative in Congress without delay.

As one of the only Latino owned and operated political consulting firms in Washington, Solidarity Strategies is committed to standing with Hispanic leaders and communities. For more than 15 years we have delivered messaging, strategy, and media campaigns that strengthen Hispanic representation in Congress. We are proud to support leaders who fight for their constituents, and we will continue pushing for the accountability and action our families deserve.

Today is an important step forward for Arizona and for our democracy. Congratulations to Representative Adelita Grijalva on her confirmation, and thank you to every partner who helped make this moment possible.
---
|
With gratitude,
Chuck Rocha + Team Solidarity Strategies

* **Colette R. Jenkins** , Albany City Commission, Ward 5: Defeated a longtime conservative incumbent and expanded Democratic control in Albany.
* **Garnet Morris** , Hiram City Council, Post 5: Flipped the seat, narrowing Republican control.
* **Gabrielle Nelson** , Port Wentworth City Council, District 1: Successfully defended this Democratic seat.
* **Eren Brumley** , Roswell City Council, Post 5: Flipped the seat, further narrowing Republican control in Roswell.

That means we’ve got to run all the way through the tape and add to last week’s wins. = With your support, we're showing the power of strategic investment in our democracy and the leaders who defend it. Statewide, both Democrats we endorsed for the George Public Service Commission — Dr. Alicia Johnson and Peter Hubbard — won their races by roughly 20 points. That's a resounding margin and the first non-federal statewide Democratic win since 2006. At the local level, we flipped three municipal seats and successfully defended two others. Colette R. Jenkins , Albany City Commission, Ward 5: Defeated a longtime conservative incumbent and expanded Democratic control in Albany. Garnet Morris , Hiram City Council, Post 5: Flipped the seat, narrowing Republican control. Gabrielle Nelson , Port Wentworth City Council, District 1: Successfully defended this Democratic seat. Eren Brumley , Roswell City Council, Post 5: Flipped the seat, further narrowing Republican control in Roswell. Melody Kelley , Sandy Springs City Council, District 2: Successfully defended this seat. Our investment included direct financial support, text messages to tens of thousands of voters, and strategic support for campaigns that typically receive little attention or resources. And turnout surpassed 1.5 million voters — exceptional for an off-year election. We've shown that in the face of an increasingly authoritarian Trump Regime, we can still push back when we fight side by side. And with the runoffs just weeks away, followed by the critical 2026 midterms, we have to be ready to elect more pro-voter leaders at all levels of government — who will defend our freedoms, stand up for Georgians, and protect the right to vote. = In solidarity, Fair Fight | = | 1270 Caroline Street | Suite D120-430 | Atlanta, GA 30307 ©2025 Fair Fight - All rights reserved. disclaimer_text: Paid for by Powered by People, [poweredxpeople
body:
#
Beto is hitting the road—and it’s going to be an action-packed few days.
Today, he’ll be in Houston, registering voters and signing up volunteers at the University of Houston to grow our grassroots power.
On Friday, he heads to San Antonio, visiting the University of Texas at San Antonio for more voter registration before holding an evening organizing rally to recruit local candidates to run for office.
Then, on Saturday, he’ll be at the Texas Tribune Festival, connecting directly with voters from across the state and sharing our positive vision for the future.
Here’s the thing: _none of this would be possible without you._ Powered by People isn’t funded by big corporations or billionaires. It’s fueled by working-class people, volunteers, and grassroots supporters who believe that **real change comes from the ground up.**
[**So, will you chip in $3 to Powered by People today to fuel our organizing work in every part of Texas? Your support keeps Beto on the road—registering voters, recruiting volunteers, and building the kind of movement that can actually win in Texas.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20251113.hHvBML&refcode=ema20251113-240458&t=2&akid=240458%2E444211%2E1zbtXF)

Minnesota is a warning for the nation: far-Left leaders like Tim Walz choose radical policies over the safety and prosperity of everyday Americans.

My name is Kendall Qualls. I wasn’t born into privilege or power. I was raised in Harlem, New York, in the 1960s; a child of divorce and one of several siblings living in public housing. Before I reached middle school, I moved to a trailer park in Oklahoma to live with my father. Neither of my parents finished high school.
I didn’t take shortcuts. I worked full-time to put myself through college. I used student loans and paid them back in full. I served as an officer in the United States Army. I earned an MBA from the University of Michigan. Then, I spent 30 years leading teams and driving innovation in the healthcare industry — rising to become Global Vice President of an $850 million business unit.
Now, I’m running for Governor of Minnesota to make sure that the principles that lifted me - hard work, faith, family, personal responsibility, and the free enterprise system - are preserved, defended, and passed on to the next generation.
We don’t need more government. We need more opportunities.
That’s what I’m fighting for, and I need your help. [Can I count on your support today?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zgvct5hnhfq6k31vm4sin977hhrpckn1gbfpbt8o_rp22sh2s8i6eor6c1jmcp76cdh2bs)
With gratitude,Kendall Qualls

When you get your gear, you’re making a statement that goes far beyond what you wear. subject: We’re going to the Supreme Court AGAIN!
body:
I want you to hear this from me before it goes public: I’m launching Judicial Watch’s end-of-year campaign early. Why? Because the fight to ensure we have honest elections in 2026 has already begun.

| [ | |
---
|
--- ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=77719&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2) |
---
| Dear Fellow American,

As a loyal follower of our work, I want you to hear this from me before it goes public: I'm launching Judicial Watch's end-of-year campaign early.

Why? _Because the fight to ensure we have honest elections in 2026 has already begun_.

My team is already seeing a Soros-funded network of left-wing groups and partisan activists working to **weaken voter ID laws** , **expand ballot harvesting** , **permit non-citizen voting** , and continue **counting ballots turned in 14 days late**.
| [ PLEASE GIVE NOW TO DEFEND ELECTION INTEGRITY IN 2026 ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=77719&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

These efforts are real, and _the Left 's determination to enact these schemes is stronger than ever before_ 2026 even begins.

Since it's not even Thanksgiving yet, these bad actors think no one is looking,

**But they 're wrong.**

Judicial Watch stands ready to respond in court _any time_ Radical Leftist activists try to dismantle the laws that protect fair and honest elections.

Judicial Watch's donors are banding together to fund election integrity work across the nation:

* **Announced just days ago:****The United States Supreme Court will review Judicial Watch 's landmark Mississippi win on election integrity _._** This case seeks to uphold Judicial Watch's win in the Fifth Circuit last year, where the court struck down a state law allowing ballots to be counted up to 5 days after Election Day. Mississippi attempted to overturn this ruling, and now the Supreme Court's review of our victory gives a chance to affirm the correct ruling of the Fifth Circuit and establish strong precedent in the highest court in the land that _ballots must be received by Election Day to be counted_.
* We also just appeared before the U.S Supreme Court against the state of Illinois' reckless practice of counting ballots received up to 14 days after Election Day.

* We are fighting a very similar late-ballot-counting practice in California.

Our election-law team has already compelled states, counties, and major cities to remove more than **5 million outdated or ineligible names** from voter rolls under the _National Voter Registration Act_.

On top of the litigation above, our attorneys are also developing **_new_** legal strategies to assist states that have enacted conservative election law reforms against the Soros network of "legal bomb throwers."

_That 's why I'm preparing for our end-of year campaign so early_.

Entering 2026 fully funded will ensure we can respond immediately to any new threats without compromising our current work.

**To keep pace, we must raise $9.6 million more by December 31 st**.

_[Please consider making a first-time gift today so we can close 2025 strong and roll straight into a pivotal 2026 with our war chest filled to the brim](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=77719&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)_.

[ GIVE NOW TO FUND THE ADVANCE LAUNCH OF OUR 2026 ELECTION INTEGRITY INITIATIVES ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=77719&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

No other organization has a better record at defending the rule of law than Judicial Watch. But fighting the Deep State and its Soros funded Leftist groups takes real money.

So, thank you for considering a first-time contribution to _fuel our fight for Election Integrity in 2026_.

I'd be grateful to have you by our side.

Sincerely,

Tom Fitton
President, Judicial Watch

P.S. I wanted you to hear from me that we’re launching our year-end campaign in just a few days. With attacks from coordinated Leftist groups to undermine Election Integrity next year already pouring in, we cannot afford to wait. [Please become a Judicial Watch donor today by making a gift to help us launch our 2026 work!](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=77719&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)

| | Dorian Gray glanced at the picture, and suddenly an uncontrollable feeling of hatred for Basil Hallward came over him, as though it had been suggested to him by the image on the canvas, whispered into his ear by those grinning lips. The mad passions of a hunted animal stirred within him, and he loathed the man who was seated at the table, more than in his whole life he had ever loathed anything. He glanced wildly around. Something glimmered on the top of the painted chest that faced him. His eye fell on it. He knew what it was. It was a knife that he had brought up, some days before, to cut a piece of cord, and had forgotten to take away with him. He moved slowly towards it, passing Hallward as he did so. As soon as he got behind him, he seized it and turned round. Hallward stirred in his chair as if he was going to rise. He rushed at him and dug the knife into the great vein that is behind the ear, crushing the man’s head down on the table and stabbing again and again. There was a stifled groan and the horrible sound of some one choking with blood. Three times the outstretched arms shot up convulsively, waving grotesque, stiff-fingered hands in the air. He stabbed him twice more, but the man did not move. Something began to trickle on the floor. He waited for a moment, still pressing the head down. Then he threw the knife on the table, and listened. He could hear nothing, but the drip, drip on the threadbare carpet. He opened the door and went out on the landing. The house was absolutely quiet. No one was about. For a few seconds he stood bending over the balustrade and peering down into the black seething well of darkness. Then he took out the key and returned to the room, locking himself in as he did so. The thing was still seated in the chair, straining over the table with bowed head, and humped back, and long fantastic arms. Had it not been for the red jagged tear in the neck and the clotted black pool that was slowly widening on the table, one would have said that the man was simply asleep. How quickly it had all been done! He felt strangely calm, and walking over to the window, opened it and stepped out on the balcony. The wind had blown the fog away, and the sky was like a monstrous peacock’s tail, starred with myriads of golden eyes. He looked down and saw the policeman going his rounds and flashing the long beam of his lantern on the doors of the silent houses. The crimson spot of a prowling hansom gleamed at the corner and then vanished. A woman in a fluttering shawl was creeping slowly by the railings, staggering as she went. Now and then she stopped and peered back. Once, she began to sing in a hoarse voice. The policeman strolled over and said something to her. She stumbled away, laughing. A bitter blast swept across the square. The gas-lamps flickered and became blue, and the leafless trees shook their black iron branches to and fro. He shivered and went back, closing the window behind him.

Ivan Dmytrovych Sirko was born in the early seventeenth century, approximately between 1605 and 1610. This is evidenced primarily by the results of research on Sirko's remains, according to which the Cossack ataman was 70-75 years old at the time of his death in 1680. The first researcher of Sirko's biography, the famous Ukrainian historian Dmytro Yavornytskyi, suggested that the future ataman was born in Sloboda Ukraine in the settlement of Merefa (now the city of Merefa, Kharkiv region). However, this is not true. Merefa was founded only in 1658, i.e. when Sirko was in his late teens. However, Sirko and his family lived in Merefa for a long time in his house, and after his death, his wife and some family members lived there. The fact that Merefa in Slobozhanshchyna is associated with the name of the Cossack Ataman is evidenced by another name for the town recorded in some Ukrainian chronicles, Sirkivka. Where, then, should we look for Sirko's homeland? In our opinion, the sources give grounds to localize it in Eastern Podillia, namely in the Vinnytsia region. It is worth recalling that Sirko was a colonel in Vinnytsia (Kalnytsia) in 1658-1660. As you know, at that time in Ukraine, people who came from the local area were usually elected to such positions. Let us also recall a letter from Hetman of the Left Bank Ukraine Ivan Samoilovych to the tsarist voivode Prince G. Romodanovsky of April 20, 1675*, which recounts (in Russian) Sirko's own words: "And since I was born among the Poles, I want to die there." Thus, it is clear that Sirko was born on the Ukrainian lands that were under the rule of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, not Muscovy (the latter included Slobozhanshchyna). The historian Volodymyr Borysenko's assumption that Sirko's birthplace was the hundred-man town of the Bratslav regiment Murafa, a few kilometers from Kalnyk, is correct. Now it is the village of Zhdanov, Vinnytsia region. By the way, Murafa in the Slobozhanshchyna probably originated from this Murafa, because immigrants from the Right Bank of Ukraine to the Left Bank often gave the newly founded settlements the names of their native villages or towns. It is also worth noting Sirko's great interest in Keleberda, which he founded in 1675 on the left bank of the Dnipro. For a long time, he sought from the Moscow tsar the right to own this town or sloboda, as well as the strategically important crossing of the Dnipro near Perevolochna (Sirko wanted this crossing not for himself, but for the entire Zaporozhian Lowland Army). Contrary to popular belief, we believe that Sirko did not come from a Cossack family, but from a small Ukrainian Orthodox gentry. For example, we know the name of a Podillia nobleman, Voytekh Sirko, who was married to a certain Olena Kozynska. Sources mention them in 1592. It is possible that they were relatives of the Cossack leader. Perhaps it is no coincidence that the kings of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, writing to Sirko, called him "urodzon." The word "nobleman" evokes negative associations for many people due to stereotypes instilled in school textbooks of the Stalinist era. However, this approach is not always correct. The term "nobleman" is identical to the words "knight," "chevalier," "nobleman," etc. and was commonly used not only in Poland but also in Ukraine, Belarus, and the Czech Republic. If scholars in Russia, Poland, and the Czech Republic, having contracted vulgar sociologism, no longer accuse Pushkin or Bunin, Suvorov or Kutuzov, Žižka or Kostiushko of being of noble or gentry origin, why have attacks on the Ukrainian and Belarusian gentry continued until recently? Is it not because in this way the imperial "divide and conquer" was transferred to our long-suffering history? Was it not because it was necessary to impose a nihilistic attitude toward the history of Ukraine, to "prove" that Ukrainians or Belarusians were just dark labor without national consciousness, ethnographic material doomed to build other people's empires? Meanwhile, the Ukrainian gentry produced many outstanding sons of Ukraine, fighters for its freedom. Suffice it to mention the names of Kryshtof Kosinski, Petro Konashevych-Sahaidachny, Ivan Sulyma, Ivan Mazepa, Bohdan Khmelnytsky, and his associates: Ivan and Danylo Vyhovsky, Ivan Bohun, Danylo and Ivan Nechai, Mykhailo Krychevsky, Jan Sokolovsky, Siluyan Muzhylovsky, and others. Sirko's appearance and personality do not always coincide with the conventional ideas about him that have developed in some works of art. The Cossack leader was slightly taller than average (174-176 cm), had regular facial features, and a straight nose. By the way, the great Relin intuitively caught this when he depicted him in the center of his painting "Cossacks Writing a Letter to the Turkish Sultan." It is interesting that the prototype for Sirko's image in the painting was the famous military leader General Dragomirov. Only one significant detail was not known to Repin and his consultant D. Yavornytskyi - a red birthmark on Sirko's lower lip on the right side. His contemporaries considered it a "sign of God" given to distinguish him from ordinary people. The Grand Hetman of the Crown, the future King of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, Jan Sobieski, who knew Sirko well and met him in Bratslav in 1671.

# Musk's xAI startup rockets to a $200 Billion
Elon Musk's xAI has now **[secured a massive $15 billion](https://substack.com/redirect/86c1ccce-186c-4016-8efa-3a5db42baed7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in fresh funding from investors, fueling the AI arms race with billions earmarked for cutting-edge graphics processing units.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/86c1ccce-186c-4016-8efa-3a5db42baed7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Valuation Skyrockets Further** : The latest infusion of $5 billion builds on the $10 billion raised in September that takes the valuation of xAI to a $200 billion valuation.
* **Cash Fuels GPU Buildout** : Much of the new capital will directly fund purchases of graphics processing units essential for training large language models.
* **AI Funding Frenzy Intensifies** : Sky-high valuations dominate the sector amid explosive demand for foundational AI models from startups.
* **Rivals Raise Billions Too** : Competitors like Anthropic raised $13B round, and OpenAI who raised $6.6B are chasing chase trillion-dollar ambitions in the heated AI arms race.

# Toyota opens $13.9B battery facility in North Carolina providing 5,100 new jobs
Toyota **[launched production Wednesday](https://substack.com/redirect/a9fd0ac3-caf3-4016-ad71-974a2cbfc2b1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** at its sprawling $13.9 billion battery factory in Liberty, North Carolina -- its first outside Japan -- while pledging another $10 billion in U.S. investments to accelerate electrified vehicle manufacturing.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a9fd0ac3-caf3-4016-ad71-974a2cbfc2b1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Massive Job Creation Surge** : The facility is expected to generate up to 5,100 American jobs in manufacturing and support roles.
* **Huge Production Capacity Ahead** : The plant targets 30 GWh annually from 14 lines, powering hybrids and Toyota's first U.S.-built all-electric three-row SUV.
* **Record-Breaking Investment Total** : The new commitments push Toyota's cumulative U.S. spending to nearly $60 billion over seven decades.
* **Expansive Employee Amenities Offered** : Toyota plans to provide on-site childcare, a medical clinic, a pharmacy, and a fitness center for employees to transform the site into a "vibrant community."

# Palantir CEO has a stark warning for AI competitors about the future
Palantir CEO Alex Karp **[fired off a stark warning Thursday](https://substack.com/redirect/16e6e668-d40c-4830-b874-3f68a3756919?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that vast chunks of the booming AI market may flop spectacularly, failing to generate enough real-world value to cover skyrocketing development and implementation costs.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/16e6e668-d40c-4830-b874-3f68a3756919?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Two Distinct AI Markets** : Karp divides AI into basic "enhanced intelligence" tools that don't move the needle on revenue or margins, versus elite applications delivering rapid, quantifiable gains in business or warfare.
* **Consumer AI "Very Weak"**: He dismissed the hype around consumer-facing AI products as fragile and already "dissipating," unlikely to justify massive investments.
* **Palantir Dominates Proven AI** : Karp asserted his company leads the narrow but lucrative subset of AI that produces dramatic, measurable results--boosting margins, revenue, or even battlefield outcomes--for enterprises and governments.
* **Echoes Broader Bubble Fears** : His caution aligns with dire predictions from investors like Jim Chanos and Michael Burry, plus tech titans, as hyperscalers plan to pour nearly $500B into data centers next year alone.

# Disney doubles net income but stock plunges 10% after earnings report
Disney **[stunned Wall Street Thursday](https://substack.com/redirect/593344d8-ad7e-4246-83a0-eb6f0f695f32?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** by more than doubling net income to $1.44 billion in fiscal Q4, crushing EPS expectations at $1.11 per share despite missing revenue forecasts. Post-earnings release the stock plunged nearly 10%.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/593344d8-ad7e-4246-83a0-eb6f0f695f32?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Streaming Turns Profitable Fast** : Combined direct-to-consumer business posted $352 million in operating income, up 39%, with Disney+ adding 3.8 million subs to hit 131.6 million total.
* **Experiences Segment Crushes Records** : Parks and cruise revenue jumped 6% to $8.77 billion while operating income rose 13% to $1.88 billion on higher guest spending and bookings.
* **Linear TV Drags Results** : Entertainment revenue fell 6% amid declining ad sales and no political boost, pulling linear networks income down 21%.
* **Big Rewards for Shareholders Ahead** : Company plans to double fiscal 2026 share buybacks and substantially increase its dividend payout.

**DISNEY 'S $30M WEEKLY HEMORRHAGE EXPOSED!**
Disney is bleeding an estimated **[$30 million per week in lost carriage fees](https://substack.com/redirect/c6c41487-7ac0-4a71-8e36-7e98646fd0d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as a bitter contract dispute with YouTube TV blacked out ESPN, ABC and other channels for a 13th straight day, analysts say.
* **Analysts Forecast Quick Resolution** : Morgan Stanley predicts the blackout will end later this week after nearly two weeks of stalemate.
* **Earnings Hit Keeps Growing** : Each week without a deal shaves $0.02 off Disney's adjusted earnings per share.
* **YouTube Offers Subscriber Credit** : Google-owned YouTube TV is giving customers a $20 credit to offset the loss of Disney networks.
* **Disney Blames Below-Market Demands** : Executives say YouTube TV refuses fair terms, rejecting even a temporary Election Day restoration of ABC.

# **The US Penny is no more after 232 years**
The U.S. Mint **[struck its final circulating penny Wednesday,](https://substack.com/redirect/82a5c650-d5fa-4c2e-8d99-51cacccf1312?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** ending production of the iconic Lincoln branded one-cent coin after 232 years as soaring manufacturing costs -- now 3.69 cents per penny -- and dwindling everyday use rendered it economically unsustainable.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/82a5c650-d5fa-4c2e-8d99-51cacccf1312?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Production Costs Skyrocketed** : Expenses rose from 1.42 cents to 3.69 cents per penny over the past decade, causing the Treasury to lose $85 million on pennies last year alone.
* **Final Coin Ceremony Held** : Treasurer Brandon Beach minted the last circulating penny in Philadelphia, with acting Mint director Kristie McNally hailing its 232-year legacy in American commerce.
* **Billions Still Circulating** : An estimated 300 billion pennies remain in existence -- far more than needed -- so retailers can continue one-cent pricing without new coins.
* **Nickel Problem Looms Next** : Eliminating the penny could boost demand for loss-making nickels, which cost even more to produce and drained $18 million from the Treasury last year.

* * *
MAGA world and the Republican Party are in a full-blown meltdown over these Epstein emails that implicate Donald Trump (and many others) in these crimes. And I want to take a moment to set aside the morality of what's unfolding and focus purely on the politics--because understanding the White House's moves right now depends on this.
First off--and I said this yesterday while debating Alan Dershowitz on Piers Morgan (yes, that actually happened)--Donald Trump, Pam Bondi, and the rest of them have made a very deliberate call: the chaos and speculation around the Epstein files and Trump's ties to Epstein are better for them politically than the truth. They'd rather let us spiral in uncertainty about what might be in those files than just release them and deal with the consequences.
And I suspect that's because those files might contain images or videos--maybe of Trump doing something very, very wrong. I don't know for sure. He may or may not be guilty of abusing women alongside Epstein, but he's absolutely guilty of _something_. And based on how they're all acting, they look guilty as hell.
At a minimum, the range of what could be in there runs from Trump knowing about Epstein's crimes and doing nothing--now covering it up for himself and his rich, powerful friends--all the way to Trump actively participating. And they've clearly calculated that politically. Because for them, endless speculation is better than cold, hard facts. They're letting Democrats and the media drip this stuff out. They're letting Twitter and TikTok fill in the blanks. They're sending out MAGA influencers with binders and memes to run interference while they stall and spin.
**Politically? This is terrible for Trump on every level.**
* * *
_**[Endless Urgency is free to read, but we're hustling to launch our new content studio and expand our team with a video editor. If you've been enjoying the work, now's the time to back it. Paid subscribers make it possible--just $8/month makes a huge difference: ](https://substack.com/redirect/020719b9-e353-42eb-a1d9-4dbedbdcb6c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_

* * *
Now to be clear--I don't think the Epstein scandal is going to be the one thing that takes him down. This isn't some new liberal conspiracy designed to be the silver bullet. I don't think there _is_ a single silver bullet--except maybe the economy. That's the real killer. Affordability. Trump's total refusal to acknowledge how bad things are for working Americans. His inability to deliver anything. The flailing panic is visible.
But the Epstein story? It screws them in three distinct ways.
1. It totally distracts from what they want to talk about--his so-called foreign policy "wins," the economy, that ugly-ass change he's making to the White House, whatever. Instead, they're stuck in a swamp of speculation and damage control.
2. It energizes Democrats. We want the truth. We want to know what Trump did. What Bannon did. If Elon Musk was on that plane. Why Peter Thiel was hanging out with Epstein--which, by the way, is confirmed in these emails. We want answers. And at a time when the Democratic Party is still reeling from last year's losses, this gives us a rallying point.
3. It fractures the Republican base. When your movement is built on conspiracy theories--and you promise to "expose the pedos" and "drain the swamp"--but then cover it all up, your base turns on you. And they should. These people were misled. They believed QAnon nonsense about Hillary running a child sex ring out of a pizza shop. They were wrong about _that_ --but they weren't wrong that sex trafficking is real. Epstein proves that. Diddy proves that. And Trump? He's failed on both fronts. He's blocking the Epstein files. He's _in_ them. And now he's talking about commuting Diddy's sentence. It's a perfect storm of hypocrisy.

* * *

* * *
Yesterday on Piers Morgan, I debated Eric Bolling from Fox News. He asked, "Well, Mike, if there's a smoking gun, why hasn't the Biden administration released it?"
Here's the answer: Because it's not just Trump. These files likely implicate high-profile people from both parties. Donors. Celebrities. Power players. And there's a certain class in this country that protects its own--even when it's politically stupid to do so. That's why Democrats didn't push harder on this before. But as we rebuild a new Democratic Party, that's changing.
Because there are 2,000 victims--young women and men abused by Epstein, Ghislaine Maxwell, and others. They deserve justice. At the very least, the public deserves to know who was involved. Even if they're never prosecuted, they should be exposed.
It's the same energy as the Wall Street collapse. No one went to prison for wrecking the economy. People lost homes, jobs, entire lives--and Wall Street walked. Meanwhile, how many people are rotting in prison over a third candy bar or a little weed?
But if you hurt kids? You're rich? You're fine. That's the system we're dealing with.
So yes--this fires up the left, fractures the right, and pisses off independents. It also completely derails the GOP's agenda. Trump already looks like a lame duck. Now he's a panicked one.
He's dragging people into the Situation Room--the place for actual national security emergencies--to hold strategy sessions about the Epstein files. CNN reported that he pulled in Pam Bondi and others for a "candid" talk in the goddamn Situation Room. What would _Veep_ do with that?
He's calling the few Republicans who signed the Epstein discharge petition, trying to peel them off. Almost flipped Lauren Boebert. Nancy Mace is scheming her way through it. It's desperation all the way down.
Meanwhile, MAGA influencers are yelling, "This is just a distraction from the shutdown compromise!" No. It's not. And I'm still mad about that garbage shutdown deal. This is something else entirely.
This is about accountability. You can't tell me only one person--Ghislaine Maxwell--is going to serve time for this. Especially when she's probably going to get her sentence commuted by Trump, with the help of his personal attorney who's basically running the Justice Department now. Probably on the last day of his presidency--just like always. Wait it out, keep quiet, get your freedom.
Hell, he just pardoned Rudy Giuliani a couple days ago. What a fucking joke.
* * *

* * *
**Bottom line:** Trump and his people have two terrible options. Stick with the chaos, look guilty as hell. Or release the truth and be guilty as hell.
These files are coming out. Oversight will get them. Other groups will too. The only question is whether we'll see the videos, the images--and who's in them. Will we get the full truth or will the evidence have been destroyed?
And morally? We need to show the American people that _this_ is where we draw the line. That the new Democratic Party fights for justice. That we hold predators and power-hungry creeps accountable--even when they're rich and famous. Maybe especially when they're rich and famous.
This is our shot to prove we're not the party of excuses and polite press releases. We are the party that punches back against corruption and power abuse.
Let's keep doing it.
Don't let them gaslight you.
Don't let them change the subject.
**This matters --morally and politically.**

name: Jack Schlossberg
subject: Trump's response to our campaign
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?refcode=111325_1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?refcode=111325_1]
It's official...
I'm running to represent NY-12 in Congress! This is the district where I was born and raised, and the place that five generations of my family have called home.
Hi Peter, I'm Jack Schlossberg, and my grandfather, President Kennedy, is my hero.
In high school, I spent hours watching his speeches. He taught us all that politics isn't about serving yourself — it's about serving others. And that's exactly why I'm running for Congress.
This isn't going to be your average campaign — we’re at the forefront of a movement backed by real people who are ready for a new generation of leadership. I won't be bought or intimidated. Instead, I'll be relying on folks like you. So, if you're willing to be one of the first donors to my campaign, will you split a donation between myself and Real Texas PAC right now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?refcode=111325_1]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation to Jack Schlossberg and The Real Texas PAC will go through immediately:
DONATE $5 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?express_lane=true&refcode=111325_1&amount=5]
DONATE $10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?express_lane=true&refcode=111325_1&amount=10]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?express_lane=true&refcode=111325_1&amount=50]
DONATE $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?express_lane=true&refcode=111325_1&amount=100]
DONATE $250 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?express_lane=true&refcode=111325_1&amount=250]
Other Amount [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?refcode=111325_1&amount=25]
I've always been passionate about politics — you can probably gather as much if you've seen any of my social media posts :) I pride myself on my hot (correct!) takes. But public service has always been my driving force. I come from a long legacy of public service, from my great-great-grandparents to my mother, Caroline Kennedy.
I have big shoes to fill. I've known it all my life. But this is even bigger than living up to my family name. This is about serving the people of New York — the city that shaped me into the person I am today.
Right now, our country is in crisis. Donald Trump and his buddies (my cousin RFK Jr. — to name just one) are tanking the economy, attacking free speech, and sowing distrust in decades of scientific research.
We need to revive empathy and effort. I want to be excited and feel hopeful about our future, and I want my fellow New Yorkers to feel the same way. I believe in a politics that works for the people it was intended to serve, and I'm ready to fight for it.
And Peter, I happen to think caring is cool.
None of this will be easy. But in the words of my grandfather, I'm doing this "Not because it is easy but because it is hard."
Together, we can build a new Congress and a New York City that works for everyone. Will you join our movement today by splitting a donation of any amount between my campaign and Real Texas PAC ? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?refcode=111325_1]
Talk soon,
Jack

Not long ago, Dr. Shafir Botner, director of MAGEN DAVID ADOM’s paramedic school and a Medevac helicopter paramedic, was treating injured civilians at the scene of a rocket strike in Be’er Sheva, Israel, when he looked up and recognized a familiar face. There, working alongside the MAGEN DAVID ADOM team to assist the injured civilians was Chief Inspector Or Yosef of the Israel Police.

The last time Dr. Botner had seen him, Inspector Yosef was fighting for his life after being critically wounded by an RPG while helping civilians during the Nova Music Festival massacre on October 7, 2023.

A MAGEN DAVID ADOM paramedic was treating the inspector when he realized Yosef would not survive long enough to make it to the hospital in his ambulance. So, he immediately called for a helicopter.

When Dr. Botner and his crew landed, they quickly loaded Inspector Yosef into the helicopter.
They knew every second mattered
https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?xtl=27csxi8i3xkmuxbagqh27val6i0yoa4tc92eynl2zfq8l0rnv0p5j9efy541n8cl7ylb1g3d0tses42vce50vzz1g9xitsdebvls31a9z1mgishllgtyhd13un5972d6cei3hk28l67y3cnmqxx&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t5ok0n&__onlt=t
.

“He was in very serious condition and had lost a massive amount of blood.

I did everything I could for him.”

But now, this patient who so nearly died on October 7 was not only still alive, he was also outside helping others. Seeing Inspector Yosef up on his feet and back on the job filled Dr. Botner with emotion.

“Or Yosef is truly an inspiration. To return to the field after such a devastating injury and help others injured in a missile attack — that’s extraordinary.”

I wish you could go with me sometime when I visit the MAGEN DAVID ADOM National Dispatch Center just outside Tel Aviv or one of the 206 MAGEN DAVID ADOM emergency medical stations located across Israel. There you will encounter some of the most extraordinary men and women you may ever meet.

There is something about the determination and compassion I see in their faces that always moves me. They are there to save lives.

These wins help safeguard Virginians against threats like voter suppression, abortion restrictions, and cuts to basic services. We’re clearly fighting for better Democrats.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/119227498/582358178/1328794144?refcode=ea.b01261b5-c9c0-f011-8196-6045bdfe8e9c&ms=ea.b01261b5-c9c0-f011-8196-6045bdfe8e9c&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImIwMTI2MWI1LWM5YzAtZjAxMS04MTk2LTYwNDViZGZlOGU5YyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=drmscfmqtISUW_SQkoiNAI0QA8CxpRGaIm826f_U-OQ=&emci=edeac3ae-c9c0-f011-8196-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=b01261b5-c9c0-f011-8196-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=4823105)

Words alone can't describe what happened in Virginia last week. On Tuesday, voters delivered a resounding rejection of Donald Trump's attacks on our climate and democracy — and they did it in the most decisive way possible. **Every single climate champion we endorsed in Virginia this year won their race.** Not most of them. Not almost all of them. Every. Single. One. That's a total of 22 climate champions elected this year. **Democrats now hold their largest majority in the Virginia House of Delegates in three decades,** soaring to at least 64 seats. That's a gain of 13 seats, including 9 Republican-held districts our JanePAC-endorsed candidates flipped on Tuesday night. **It was also a night of firsts.** Our endorsed climate champion, Ghazala Hashmi, became Virginia's first Muslim woman elected to statewide office as Lieutenant Governor, while Democrats swept every statewide race and reclaimed full control of the executive branch. **And to top it all off: Virginia turned blue — everywhere.** Republicans flooded the airwaves with attack ads targeting the most competitive districts in Virginia, Big Oil spent millions to protect their profits, and still, **all but 5 of the state’s 95 counties shifted toward Democrats.** I’m incredibly proud of this movement and of the climate champions we’ve elected together. Because we’re not just fighting Republicans. **We’re clearly fighting for better Democrats — the kind who have a backbone, who lead with courage, who do what’s right even when it’s not easy.** **[At 87, I have no plans of slowing down, but I need the help of people like you who’ve stood with me before and never backed away from what's important. clean_body: We’re clearly fighting for better Democrats. | Words alone can't describe what happened in Virginia last week. On Tuesday, voters delivered a resounding rejection of Donald Trump's attacks on our climate and democracy — and they did it in the most decisive way possible. Every single climate champion we endorsed in Virginia this year won their race. Not most of them. Not almost all of them. Every. Single. One. That's a total of 22 climate champions elected this year. Democrats now hold their largest majority in the Virginia House of Delegates in three decades, soaring to at least 64 seats. That's a gain of 13 seats, including 9 Republican-held districts our JanePAC-endorsed candidates flipped on Tuesday night. It was also a night of firsts. Our endorsed climate champion, Ghazala Hashmi, became Virginia's first Muslim woman elected to statewide office as Lieutenant Governor, while Democrats swept every statewide race and reclaimed full control of the executive branch. And to top it all off: Virginia turned blue — everywhere. Republicans flooded the airwaves with attack ads targeting the most competitive districts in Virginia, Big Oil spent millions to protect their profits, and still, all but 5 of the state’s 95 counties shifted toward Democrats. I’m incredibly proud of this movement and of the climate champions we’ve elected together. Because we’re not just fighting Republicans. name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 11/13/2025
body:
The sky is not falling, my friends
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
Listen to today's Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** In Douglas County, the outgoing conservative school board pushed last-minute measures to [extend charter renewals and protect fairness in girls’ sports](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) before a progressive majority takes over. In Colorado Springs, the City Council narrowly voted 5–4 to delay a [vehicle camping ban](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) after heated debate over “criminalizing homelessness.” Meanwhile, the Waltman family’s five-year battle for answers about the death of 91-year-old Vira Waltman during COVID lockdowns raised [disturbing questions about state accountability](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Attorney General Phil Weiser also drew fire for his [“anti-Trump” redistricting proposal](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), criticized as costly and partisan. And with [no new Colorado River agreement](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) among seven Western states, water uncertainty deepens as reservoirs hit record lows.
**🇺🇸 On the National Stage...** At UC Berkeley, a Turning Point USA event turned violent as Antifa activists threw projectiles and lit flares—[yet CBS News called it “mostly peaceful.”](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Meanwhile, new data revealed Obamacare’s hidden windfall for major insurers, whose [profits jumped 200% since 2010](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) thanks to $1.8 trillion in taxpayer subsidies expanded under Biden—fueling Trump’s criticism of the program as a payoff to corporate donors.
🗣️ **Commentary Spotlight...** Heidi Ganahl’s “The Sky Is Not Falling, My Friends” cuts through the chaos with perspective. She points to steady inflation, record-low gas prices, fewer border crossings, revived energy independence, and restored fairness in women’s sports as signs of national renewal. Her reminder: [optimism—not outrage—is what keeps America strong](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, November 13, 2025.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[The sky is not falling, my friends](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY HEIDI GANAHL, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_It’s easy to get swept up in the daily drama of social media — the sky-is-falling headlines, the endless doomscrolling, the “we’re doomed” takes from people who haven’t walked outside to notice the mountains still standing tall. But every so often, someone breaks through the noise with a dose of reality._
_That’s what podcaster Dan Hollaway did last week on X when he responded to a viral claim that “this administration is losing young voters because it’s obsessed with Israel.” His reply? A blistering reality check that could double as a highlight reel of what’s actually working in America right now._
_Let’s look at a few of those wins — and maybe take a breath._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[A mother, a signature and a shutdown: The Waltmans’ five-year battle for answers](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **Family alleges wrongful death during COVID lockdown:** The Waltmans say 91-year-old Vira Jean Waltman died after being overmedicated with morphine and denied water at Greeley’s Good Samaritan nursing home in April 2020, despite her family’s medical power of attorney being ignored under state lockdown orders.
* **Conflicting medical claims and denied investigations:** Nurses privately told the family Vira was dehydrated, while her doctor cited nonexistent CDC “COVID guidance” supporting restricted fluids. Police and prosecutors repeatedly refused to investigate, and the county coroner denied an autopsy based on a verbal “no-COVID-autopsy” directive.
* **Five years without accountability:** After multiple rejections from law enforcement and state agencies, the Waltmans continue to seek acknowledgment and justice—insisting their mother’s death was not natural but the result of fatal negligence disguised as protocol.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
The Rocky Mountain Voice is a 501(c)(3) that exists to promote informed civic engagement and the principles of self-governance through enterprise reporting on public policy, politics, government, and culture throughout the state of Colorado. The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Weiser’s Anti-Trump Agenda Comes at Taxpayer Expense](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COMPLETE COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **Weiser pushes to scrap Colorado’s bipartisan redistricting system:** Attorney General Phil Weiser announced support for overturning the voter-approved Amendments Y and Z, which created independent commissions for drawing congressional and legislative maps, arguing the change would help elect more Democrats.
* **Critics see partisan power grab:** The article argues Weiser’s move mirrors California Democrats’ tactics to regain legislative control over redistricting, breaking bipartisan promises and undermining the independence voters intended in 2018.
* **Undermining trust and priorities:** Author Rob Natelson contends that Weiser’s political agenda distracts from his duty to address Colorado’s rising crime rates, warning that his focus on partisan advantage comes at taxpayers’ expense.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
[**The Voice of Colorado: A Call to Engage, Write, and Lead Together**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
**BY DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | NOVEMBER 11** _Across Colorado—from the Eastern Plains to the peaks of the Rockies and Western Slope—every community has a story worth sharing. Yet too many of these stories remain dormant and unheard. At Rocky Mountain Voice (RMV), we’re changing that by reigniting civic engagement and rebuilding trust in media—one authentic and valued voice at a time._
[**The Myth of the Montrose Mandate: Low Turnout Exposes Recall Farce**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
**BY MICHAEL J BADAGLIACCO "MJB" | COMMENTARY | NOVEMBER 11** _In the world of local politics, few things are as amusing as watching a vocal minority pat themselves on the back for what they call a resounding victory. On November 4th, the recall of Montrose County Commissioner Mijares (R), has the so-called recall crew crowing about how “the people have spoken.” But let’s take a closer look at the numbers, shall we? With only 8,439 votes cast to oust Mijares out of 34,187 registered voters, that’s a paltry 25% turnout. Hardly the stuff of democratic thunder._
__
[**The cost of obedience: How Colorado’s senators strengthened economic malfeasance**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[****](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**BY MIKE O'DONNELL | COMMENTARY | NOVEMBER 11** _It is both sad and disappointing that Colorado’s two U.S. senators are incapable of independent thought. As the simple puppets of their overlords, they have selfishly voted fifteen times NOT to reopen the federal government—even though their “no” votes hurt the Coloradans they supposedly represent._
__

**Feel like you have a unique story, commentary or tip to share?** Email [submit@rockymountainvoice.com](submit@rockymountainvoice.com).
|

It was temporarily removed in 2001 for preservation and re-encasement, returning in 2003. Today, all four pages are protected behind airtight, argon-filled glass cases to safeguard the nation’s founding document.

| | Patriot,

Late Sunday night, multiple **Democrats in the Senate crossed party lines to begin the process of reopening the government.** A handful of Senate Democrats voted with Republicans to pass a bill that would fund the government until late January, giving Congress time to pass a more permanent funding solution. **One of the things I am most happy with is that Republicans virtually conceded nothing to the Democrats, thanks to President Trump and Senate Republican leadership!**
---

---
| Radical Democrats in Washington are angry that the government is reopening, as some of their colleagues in the Senate agreed to work with Republicans. Career politicians in Washington were willing to allow Americans to suffer even more if they got what they wanted on Obamacare subsidies. **Republicans said no, and now we can get back to the policies Americans voted for in 2024!**
When I am in Congress, I will reject political games in Washington, and I will refuse to sit by while Americans suffer, so that Democrats can prioritize illegal immigrants and their radical agenda!
In order to do this, we have to defeat Steven Horsford! **Will you chip in to my campaign so that NV-04 can have a Congressman who does their job in Washington?**

We have a real opportunity to bring real, positive, conservative change to Nevada, but it will take all of us working together. **I am matching every single dollar that is being donated, so your donation will have 2X the impact! Will you join our movement to flip NV-04?**

| Your support today will help us take this fight to Washington—and show Democrats what it means to serve your constituents. Every dollar you give makes a difference in ensuring our men and women in uniform get the respect they deserve.
Together, we can pass President Trump’s agenda, fight for the Americans Democrats sought to hurt during this shutdown, and ensure Democrats know that we will never give in to their ugly tactics.

Friend,

This isn’t a shutdown deal. Democrats and the American people got virtually nothing. No extension of the Affordable Care Act subsidies that keep healthcare affordable for millions of Americans. No progress for the families we promised to fight for.

We’ve fought hard to protect working families, which is why caving now makes no sense. If we can’t hold the line on something as fundamental as affordable healthcare, what are we even doing? This is yet another example of why we need new leadership. Too many in Washington are clinging to the status quo instead of leading with the urgency this moment demands. Ed Markey won’t even answer a basic question about whether he supports Schumer staying on as leader. Americans deserve better, and, at minimum, they deserve answers. That’s why, since launching this campaign, I’ve pledged not to support Schumer if he runs for party leadership again, and why it’s time to empower the next generation throughout the Senate.

We can’t keep doing the same thing and expecting different results. The American people deserve courage and accountability from the people they send to Washington, not more excuses and non-answers.

The stakes for our community and for our democracy have never been higher, Peter. The politicization of the Justice Department under Donald Trump and members of his administration showed us what happens when powerful people put politics above justice. We’ve watched the Trump DOJ refuse to prosecute his allies — even when they were caught breaking the law. One glaring example: a Virginia sheriff who took $75,000 in bribes in exchange for issuing auxiliary deputy sheriff badges was sentenced to ten years in federal prison — but Trump pardoned him before he served a single day. That’s not justice. That’s corruption. We can’t count on the Trump-aligned DOJ to defend our rights, serve our interests, or fairly uphold the rule of law for the people of North Carolina. That’s why local accountability matters now more than ever. Because of its position in the state Capitol, the Wake County District Attorney’s Office is unlike any other in North Carolina — investigating and prosecuting political corruption and government malfeasance across the state. That means the Wake County DA is likely the last line of defense against political corruption in North Carolina. And that’s why I’m running. **We need a Wake County District Attorney who will hold everyone accountable — regardless of whether they’re friends or supporters of Donald Trump.** I’m determined to stand up for our rights and freedoms, hold corrupt politicians accountable, and defend the rule of law and our Constitution. But I can’t do it alone. Moving our state forward will take all of us — working together to build a fairer, safer, more just North Carolina. For some, that might mean **[pitching in a donation](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/119230565/582369097/1409485659?refcode=AU_GWN_CL_GEN_GEN_AC_20251113_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODMxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYzBiNGIzMC1kMmMwLWYwMTEtODE5Ni02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=J-3Xzg0gvtkVLXlq4gGeknViiAr-ljT-xBEkSG7WlbA=)** to help us grow our campaign. Peter — the Arctic is at a tipping point, and it’s urgent that we hear
from you. In the midst of the longest government shutdown in history, the Trump
administration has been fast-tracking multiple plans to open Alaska’s pristine
wilderness for drilling and mining. This moment is critical for the future of some of the last remaining intact ecosystems on the planet. Please, Peter: help stop polluters from plundering Alaska’s public lands. Renew your LCV membership while membership is just $5 today >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/9zEZMdgXm3J- Here’s what we’re up against: Multiple congressional attacks on some of Alaska’s wildest places. Lawmakers recently voted to overturn safeguards across millions of acres of the Western Arctic, a move that would put ecologically vital public lands at risk from new drilling. The resurrected Ambler Road Project. This corrupt deal would carve a 200-mile industrial mining corridor through the Gates of the Arctic National Park and Preserve, pollute thousands of streams and rivers, and cause irreparable destruction to the region’s ecosystem. Opening up Alaska’s Tongass National Forest to industrial logging. The Tongass is the largest national forest in the U.S. and the last intact temperate rainforest left on the planet. The Trump administration moved to open it up to timber companies and industrial development, worsening climate change and forever altering the landscape. We’ve stopped attacks like these before, but it takes our entire movement to
organize and campaign in a major way to overcome the money and influence of
corporate polluters. We can only fight back with your support. That’s why it’s so important that you renew your membership today to defend the Arctic. soar. Now, we have momentum to block some of Trump’s worst attacks on the
Arctic, too. We’re seeing lawmakers think twice about supporting wildly
unpopular policies, but we have to keep the pressure up — and bring the demand for clean and
affordable energy back to Washington, D.C. Please, Peter: renew your LCV membership while membership is just $5 today to help us hold the line on Alaska’s public lands, clean energy, and our climate future. https://links.messages.lcv. Chris Brooks

Friend, After more than 6 weeks, Trump’s government shutdown has ended. But after all of the pain Trump perpetrated on the American people―from illegally withholding SNAP funds to illegally firing federal workers to threatening to withhold backpay from furloughed workers―the pain will not end when the government re-opens. **Health insurance costs will double for 20 million Americans under Republicans’ government funding bill, aided by a handful of Democrats.** This so-called deal does nothing to protect vulnerable people from the Medicaid and SNAP cuts passed in Trump’s Big Budget Betrayal, which will kick 17 million Americans off their healthcare. **Instead of holding the line and fighting for healthcare as a human right,********moderate Democrats negotiated this deal with Senate Republicans.** The only agreement they got was an empty promise of a Senate vote on extending the Affordable Care Act subsidies which expire at the end of the year, and Republicans are already pushing poison pills along with that vote. We must pressure Congress to hold and pass these votes now. [**Join me in demanding the House and Senate vote immediately to protect working families by extending the enhanced ACA subsidies, which have been keeping healthcare more affordable for tens of millions of people.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39taXraFna9un9GQ1JlC3VsIrz_rhGyWmjG1DglND1pNrF3DjU9VmN14kEFLlPyQE_Z-HaeQkB4uy0bvCh7kA4MmD1cAnG6E67nHsQO6uKxUd_4IQ6PP8U5tsW9OpO11BgIEK6kXbEZL3-zWFQJiCzKEeliWM51BKKOTJBaTvbgxEZElZ6Grsbp0nMQQFzgncPLER6lsnCXkM3VS9xhmwFL7BMSgR1fPX2o1Go9WEp9GMJfOvzoq72AJaUOD4y5DeGggQaD3sJKKuj3ylX3-g78MW-gzfQZL3yuYEyEBW0LwJ9HLg5MuHPAbGtbil0QGD-LppLycvuqL1laigLUX086-TklV-JnJVTwQrMtLnWVqW2bawI642UDJz_qTzV0VIA/4lk/lW1c8_SSTzWTJII07fUJwQ/h1/h001.yvbFCa2oGaB1QbUGk6jfbKnWCOutUaqzZFtGXDYVhXE) | [TAKE ACTION](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39taXraFna9un9GQ1JlC3VsIrz_rhGyWmjG1DglND1pNrF3DjU9VmN14kEFLlPyQE_Z-HaeQkB4uy0bvCh7kA4MLMOmgkbkYJRFe7E1LG47HGErHo0DP3YcqvxyM-GOe3DAeGgTWTEFEX6QoF66Buu1TSLtXCGkN-OW3wl_raDEHE4Db0OpxFJPOGVpTAHH7UT9AED8nAm-U7GOBCGy5tN44cKH2twRMW9Ic1HW10rM7EyR8OrBrRFtu4naQyxjMBV5p57OwTYRhgnP32OCZL-MOSjn0sB2zfjGSl_0sUIFN1TtsI0B8fmwfujkf41doc7myYfU2MMJquIHF5hz2ivB4Ji6vrSyAwoQ7gHHndUKClGjdr4i50FGiB2GcrUALKo/4lk/lW1c8_SSTzWTJII07fUJwQ/h2/h001.EOWyXWSk7QeCJlL1UJUYG7Sp--sj6RXrfpwbjMGQayE)

Open enrollment on the Affordable Care Act Marketplace is currently underway across the country, and many people are seeing their premiums more than double starting January 1st. If Congress lets the ACA subsidies expire, millions of Americans will be unable to afford health insurance, and many will die unnecessarily.
In addition, while the ACA subsidies have been critical to keeping healthcare costs lower, there are plenty of families in my district who are still paying a lot more than they should.
**That’s why I’m fighting for transformative changes like Medicare for All and ending medical debt.** We need a healthcare system that puts patient care before corporate profits, and the only way we will do that is by enacting Medicare for All.
[**While we continue to grow our movement for Medicare for All, we’re in the midst of a healthcare affordability crisis, and Congress must act now. Add your name to demand an immediate vote on extending the enhanced ACA subsidies so 20 million Americans can continue to afford their health insurance.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39taXraFna9un9GQ1JlC3VsIrz_rhGyWmjG1DglND1pNrF3DjU9VmN14kEFLlPyQE_Z-HaeQkB4uy0bvCh7kA4MUR1Z4DTXRRy9XQkfJK9QfFQBf3izRkvMlhGtPUER29YVmiG0LgDzYLDkC5VM17UBvvBmX9fazyCBOHP5tmAAJq8WQMlGTqxi_NkUzV5EHf0gxk-U3AtgUVC6laGhtyvYUxtnIG6dUhoFwPLeMJSB_QdwhhVIaXQCj_6DDhYbWQB397d2iOXPoC_PzBWqUDjnBzUUiNkC65mHatnMFvfKtDxH1tE6IA-BfqDe3RFYclW38b_rdjoKZXLQ_N3er5doJcz8Wb6Dlk5LHeuE2r_eUZUTCKmCA7rw_VqoQi74lJg/4lk/lW1c8_SSTzWTJII07fUJwQ/h3/h001.Nl2IAGh8VxF83gwNdDLZHkm6scGJoa0W69FJJMhn0UU)

Rashida
